endpoint_note: Skills are hand-maintained markdown; they are not generated by scripts/build_*.py.

skills.description: Surface overlooked vault tracks — the quietest plays in the archive — for playlists and deep listening.
skills.title: Deep cuts finder

skills.description: Reconstruct a recording session's story — when it happened, what came out, who was in the room — from sessions.json.
skills.title: Session archaeology

skills.description: Browse the 61 upload sessions as an explorable timeline — seasons, silences, per-session stories — from session-clusters.json.
skills.title: Session explorer

skills.description: Map any collaborator's full footprint across the discography via the circle and scene-figures endpoints.
skills.title: Collaborator tracer

skills.description: Read the collaboration network (network.json) — nodes, track-weighted edges, co-credit links, and computed insights — to answer "who works with whom" questions.
skills.title: Network graph reader

skills.description: Track vault tracks approaching round-number play counts from the milestone-watch endpoint.
skills.title: Milestone watcher

skills.description: Summarize one archive era — span, releases, numbers, story — for a writeup.
skills.title: Era briefing

skills.description: Interpret a title word through the codex — its family, its transmissions, its read.
skills.title: Transmission decoder

skills.description: Read a codex family's full deep-dive — decoded reading, era-by-era evolution, every transmission, key sessions, collaborators — from codex-families.json.
skills.title: Codex reader

skills.description: Draft a release announcement in the site's voice — ancient weight, neon signal, zero hype filler.
skills.title: Announce a release

skills.description: Build a press kit from the archive's verified data.
skills.title: Build press kit

skills.description: Verify platform links resolve before publishing.
skills.title: Verify platform links
Milestone race reader
skills.description: Read the milestone race (milestone-races.json) — approaching play-count milestones ranked by gap-closing proximity, the 30,088-play summit chase, session and era records, and the most recently crossed milestones. Pace figures are arithmetic, never predictions.

skills.title: Session compare
skills.description: Head-to-head comparison of any two of the 61 upload sessions — track counts, play totals, standout tracks, collaborator overlap — plus the transparently-formulated deepest-sessions ranking, from session-tools.json.

skills.title: Codex pathfinder
skills.description: Trace the shortest connection between any two figures through the codex relationship graph — shared collaborators/producers as edges, BFS degrees of separation from Aster, family-overlap pairs — from codex-network.json (drives codex-network.html's connect-the-dots pathfinder).
